hook: I stopped mail from touching my counter for $19.99

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a cluttered kitchen counter covered in mail, keys, and loose change
scenes.voiceover: Every night my counter looked like this.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand sweeping mail into one pile, frustrated
scenes.voiceover: Turns out the problem wasn't space. It was that nothing had a landing spot.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing the FifthQuarter Key Holder Wall Mount and mounting it near the entry
scenes.voiceover: This is the FifthQuarter Key Holder. $19.99, 6 hooks, a mail slot, rated 4.8 stars across 4,169 ratings.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hands hanging keys on the hooks and sliding mail into the slot
scenes.on_screen_text: Keys + mail, intercepted at the door
scenes.voiceover: It catches mail before it ever reaches the counter.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of the now-empty, clear kitchen counter
scenes.voiceover: Three days in, the counter's still clear.

scenes.visual_prompt: Text overlay comparing the price of the key holder to clutter bins people buy instead
scenes.on_screen_text: $19.99 vs. the bins people buy to hide the same mess
scenes.voiceover: It's cheaper than most of the bins people buy to contain the same clutter after the fact.

caption: My counter had a mail pile by Tuesday every single week - so I tried the $19.99 fix 4,169 reviewers rate 4.8 stars. The FifthQuarter Key Holder Wall Mount gives keys and mail a landing spot before they ever touch the counter. Full 5-product comparison on the blog.
